summary: Redwire Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $350 million in common stock under a new sales agreement with multiple agents. The filing replaces a prior November 2025 agreement, under which $249.7 million had already been sold. Shares are sold on a commercially reasonable efforts basis on NYSE via agents earning up to 3.0% commission. Last reported price was $8.69. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No special-situation catalyst; routine equity shelf takedown.
